notes: A second, independent query set, frozen before any scoring change was written. The v1 held-out queries already influenced the BM25 recommendation and are therefore previously inspected evaluation data; these twelve were never looked at through a candidate implementation. Query shapes are chosen to stress the known failure modes -- common-term-heavy prose, short implementation symbols, long test methods, ambiguous names -- not chosen by observing any implementation's output. Axios is a fourth corpus and a fourth language family, added so the set is not only the three repositories the v1 labels were read from.

dispatchRequest.js:34; :49 resolves the adapter and :51 calls it
InterceptorManager.js:5 holds the handlers Axios.request walks
called from dispatchRequest.js:40 before the adapter runs
getAdapter, called from dispatchRequest.js:49
